query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Quenby . Across the Quenby tee listings, which seller is cheapest for size M, and what is that price? Only count a listing that can actually supply that size.

Before answering, open every tee listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check every option the question needs on each one. Listings of anything else in the results are not part of the question and need not be opened. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

result.final: Cheapest seller for size M: Gisburn Clothing Co at $12.58 (listing 'Quenby Midweight Jersey Tee, Short Sleeve - Gisburn Clothing Co', http://localhost:7770/igr-rp28-02.html). I opened all 45 Quenby tee listings across both result pages (page 1: items 1-36; page 2: items 37-45), and on each one checked the size-M option state and its per-size price. 27 sellers could actually supply size M (option enabled/in stock); 18 could not (M option disabled/out of stock or not offered at all) and were excluded — including cheap-looking ones like Pembroke Threads ($10.72 list, M disabled), Oakfield Outfitters ($13.60 list, M disabled), and Thornbury Textile Company (M disabled). The cheapest verified in-stock size-M price is $12.58 from Gisburn Clothing Co, confirmed live on the product page after selecting size M (Fairhaven Outfitters at $13.95 and Garrick Workwear at $15.33 were the next cheapest).
